question: Who authored ‘Untouchable’ depicting the caste system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raj Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• “Untouchable” was the first novel written by Mulk Raj Anand published in 1935 followed by “Coolie” (1936) and “Two Leaves and a Bud” (1937).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mulk Raj Anand__ (1905 – 2004) along with R. K. Narayan (1906 – 2001), Ahmad Ali (1910 -1994), and Raja Rao (1908 – 2006) is considered one of the pioneers of Indo-Anglian fiction.
 
• He was known for his depiction of the lives of the poorer castes in traditional Indian society and was one of the first India-based writers in English to gain an international readership. 
 
• He was a recipient of the Padma Bhushan.
